γιγνώσκω: to learn to know, to perceive, mark, learn
καταπροδίδωμι: to betray utterly, leave in the lurch
μεταγιγνώσκω: to change one’s mind, to repent
μεταδίδωμι: to give part of, give a share of
προδίδωμι: to give beforehand, pay in advance; to betray, surrender
προκαταγιγνώσκω: to vote against beforehand, condemn by a prejudgment
ἀναβιόω: to come to life again, return to life
ἀναγιγνώσκω: to know well, know certainly; to read
ἀναλίσκω: to use up, to spend, lavish
ἀνταποδίδωμι: to give back, repay, tender in repayment
ἀπογιγνώσκω: depart from a judgment, give up a design
ἀποδίδωμι: to give back, give what is due; (mid.) sell
ἁλίσκομαι: to be caught, conquered, caught in the act
ἐκπλέω: to sail out, sail away, weigh anchor
